source: User approved process fix on 2026-05-23 after TASK-010 downstream planning gap report.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

requirements.text: Planning must resolve every accepted decision row and downstream planning question into durable knowledge/task/sprint/deferred state before implementation consumes a planning build.
Planning validation must fail or block incomplete decision-to-roadmap propagation and require superseding planning builds until the gateway passes.
Graph/status/audit evidence must expose accepted decisions whose executable rows or downstream questions have no roadmap/sprint/deferred mapping, especially before roadmap-empty task close.

evidence_mapping.criterion: Approved process rows are mapped to system knowledge.
evidence_mapping.evidence: .codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md, .codewiki/kb/system/validation-gateway.md, and .codewiki/kb/system/change-lifecycle.md record durable decision propagation, planning gateway iteration, and residual accepted-decision signals.

summary: Accept strict decision propagation and planning gateway completeness

diff_table.current_state: Planning builds can record downstream planning questions or defer executable accepted decision rows without a durable roadmap task, sprint, or owned deferred record. A later implementation/task-close path can leave the roadmap empty while accepted decision rows remain unqueued.
diff_table.desired_state: Every accepted decision row and downstream planning question must be resolved by planning into one of: product/system knowledge-only completion, executable roadmap task, sprint/cohort metadata, or explicit deferred record with owner, trigger, and rationale. Open questions alone are not durable propagation.
diff_table.rationale: User stated that everything decided should be propagated; decisions must not disappear into chat/build questions after a first task closes.
diff_table.risk: medium-high: tightens planning semantics and can block existing flows until row coverage evidence is complete.
alternatives: Keep open questions as sufficient planning evidence.
Require only high-risk rows to map to tasks.
Let task-close detect only roadmap-empty states, not row-level coverage.

diff_table.current_state: Planning validation can pass a planning_build that creates only a first atomic task while leaving accepted rows intentionally deferred without a task/sprint/deferred-owner mapping. Failed planning can be reported later, but the gateway does not force a superseding planning build before implementation proceeds.
diff_table.desired_state: Planning validation must fail or block when accepted decision rows, requirements, or downstream planning questions are not fully mapped. Compiler cycles should iterate by producing superseding planning_build attempts until the gateway passes before implementation consumes the plan.
diff_table.rationale: User stated builds should be iterated until they pass the gateway and the gateway should not approve planning when decisions are not mapped into the roadmap.
diff_table.risk: medium-high: changes gateway behavior and requires deterministic tests to avoid false blocks.
alternatives: Warn instead of fail planning validation.
Allow implementation to proceed with a partial planning build if first task is atomic.
Rely on human review to notice missing rows.

diff_table.current_state: State/graph/status can be green with roadmap open=0 even when an accepted decision build still has unresolved downstream planning questions or deferred executable rows.
diff_table.desired_state: Graph/status/audit evidence should surface unresolved accepted-decision propagation: rows/questions without task/sprint/deferred-owner mapping, especially when roadmap is empty or task-close would make it empty.
diff_table.rationale: Visible residual-work signals prevent semantic drift and route agents back to planning before work appears complete.
diff_table.risk: medium: requires a deterministic lens over builds, roadmap, validation, and closure state.
alternatives: Only document the rule and depend on planning validation.
Only surface this in UI later.

accepted_decisions.summary: Every accepted decision row and downstream planning question must be resolved by planning into one of: product/system knowledge-only completion, executable roadmap task, sprint/cohort metadata, or explicit deferred record with owner, trigger, and rationale. Open questions alone are not durable propagation.

Planning validation must fail or block when accepted decision rows, requirements, or downstream planning questions are not fully mapped. Compiler cycles should iterate by producing superseding planning_build attempts until the gateway passes before implementation consumes the plan.

Graph/status/audit evidence should surface unresolved accepted-decision propagation: rows/questions without task/sprint/deferred-owner mapping, especially when roadmap is empty or task-close would make it empty.

knowledge_changes: .codewiki/kb/system/compilers.md now requires planning row-to-roadmap propagation maps and superseding planning builds until validation passes.
.codewiki/kb/system/validation-gateway.md now defines planning validation row coverage and roadmap-empty residual accepted-decision routing.
.codewiki/kb/system/change-lifecycle.md now states accepted decisions must propagate to knowledge, tasks, sprints, implementation evidence, or explicit deferred state.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Planning and lifecycle docs define durable propagation states and reject build open questions as durable storage.
Compiler and gateway docs require planning validation to fail/block incomplete propagation and require superseding planning builds until pass.
Gateway and lifecycle docs require residual accepted-decision propagation to route back to planning before roadmap-empty completion.

system_impact: Planning builds need decision-row coverage evidence.
State/graph/audit work should expose residual accepted-decision mappings.
Task-close/roadmap-empty contexts should route unmapped accepted decisions back to planning.
propagation.no_product_impact: No end-user product behavior changes in this decision; it tightens internal CodeWiki compiler/gateway semantics to preserve decided work.

downstream_planning_questions: Implement deterministic planning-build propagation coverage checks in validation/preflight and tests.
Expose residual accepted-decision propagation in graph/status/audit evidence.
Retrofit current file-structure decision residual rows into roadmap/sprint/deferred mappings so accepted source migration and human review surface are not lost.
assumptions: The fix should preserve atomic task boundaries: follow-up tasks and sprint metadata are allowed, umbrella tasks are not.
Open questions may remain in builds only as unresolved prompts; decided executable work needs durable roadmap/sprint/deferred representation.
Existing decision builds can be used as fixtures for regression tests.
open_questions: Should the current file-structure concept-root migration be planned as one sprint or as individual concept migration tasks after the propagation gate lands?
non_goals: Do not migrate source files in this process decision.
Do not add a new user-facing command in this process decision.
Do not weaken task atomicity by creating umbrella tasks.
risks: Stricter validation may initially block planning builds that relied on open questions instead of durable row resolution.
Residual-decision detection must avoid treating knowledge-only decisions as executable missing work.
